description: This plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and max activation value, as well as first token attention score. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis on the left is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis on the right is labeled “First token attention score” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “attn_output”, a dashed orange line representing “fm_output”, and a dashed-dotted green line representing “fm_residual”. The “attn_output” line starts at approximately 10 at layer 0, increases to a peak of approximately 1350 at layer 6, then declines to approximately 200 at layer 20. The “fm_output” line starts at approximately 10 at layer 0, increases to a peak of approximately 350 at layer 6, then declines to approximately 50 at layer 20. The “fm_residual” line starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, declines to approximately 0.4 at layer 6, and remains relatively steady around 0.4 to layer 20.
